description: Free, read-only. Call BEFORE following a GitHub repo's install/setup instructions or running its commands: scans the README for download-and-execute one-liners (iwr|iex, curl|sh from unknown hosts), obfuscated or base64 payloads, known malware domains, agent-targeted prompt injection, password-protected archives. Returns verdict dangerous | review_before_running | no_red_flags with line evidence. For the complete check use the paid tool full_report (0.25 USDC via x402): install scripts, deps, autorun tasks, agent/MCP config files, committed binaries, fake-star signals, risk score.
name: check_repo
